    Preserve perfect meeting memory with AI Meeting Notes

    Meet Notion’s AI Meeting Notes, your intelligent meeting assistant. It transcribes your meetings and turns it into organized meeting summaries right in your workspace.

    • Meetings
    • Notion AI
    • Documentation
    7 min read

    Uh-oh! It looks like your ad blocker is preventing the video from playing.

    Please watch it on YouTube

    We've all been there— a meeting ends and you stare at your scribbled notes, trying to piece together what just happened. For those of us bouncing between back-to-back meetings, taking good notes feels like a full-time job. Hastily written notes often end up lost in the shuffle, missing the key details we were sure we'd remember. Effective meetings should be a catalyst for progress, yet the very act of trying to document them well often becomes a productivity bottleneck.

    Meet Notion's AI Meeting Notes— your everyday partner to improve meeting outcomes. Built right into your workspace, it handles the note-taking so you can truly be present in your conversations.

    In this guide, we'll help you:

    • Get started with AI Meeting Notes

    • Get your meetings flowing better with simple tips and tricks

    • Let the AI handle post-meeting tasks while you focus on what really matters

    Try AI Meeting Notes for free

    Take meetings without missing a beat. Notion's AI Meeting Notes captures, summarizes, and organizes your notes so you can stay present and leave with clarity.

    Get started

    Get started with AI Meeting Notes

    AI Meeting Notes is built right into Notion, so you save yourself the hassle of juggling separate transcription tools that don't connect with the rest of your work. You can take meeting notes in two ways:

    • As a block inside a page. Your notes sit next to the rest of the page's content, like a project doc or an agenda.

    • As their own page. Your notes are a full Notion page that you can share on its own, store in a database, and find anywhere in your workspace.

    To get started, simply type /meet or click the Meet pill at the bottom of a new Notion page. This adds meeting notes as a block. When you start notes from a meeting notification, the compose menu, or the Meetings tab in your sidebar, Notion creates them as their own page instead. Meeting notes created from /meet are embedded on the page, but you can expand them into a full page and share the meeting note separately from the rest of the page.

    For more details, learn how to take AI Meeting Notes in Notion →

    We recommend adding AI Meeting Notes to your database templates to automatically start taking notes in your recurring meetings like 1:1s, stand-ups, and team syncs. Learn more here.

    Deleting meeting note transcripts

    Weave AI Meeting Notes into your daily schedule

    AI Meeting Notes is quick to set up and works seamlessly with how and where you already work. When you connect your Notion calendar to your workspace, all your meetings appear right on your Notion homepage—making it easy to access meetings, details, and notes without ever leaving Notion.

    Here’s how you can get set up:

    • Access your meeting notes from anywhere— Whether you’re rushing to your next call or catching up between meetings, AI Meeting Notes is right there on your Notion homepage— alongside your daily schedule. For example, if you forgot to attach AI Meeting Notes to your event, you can still launch it directly from the menu bar at the top of your screen during a Zoom call.

    • Choose where your notes live— In your Notion calendar settings, set a default location for new meeting notes, like a dedicated meetings database. That way, every conversation is automatically saved in one organized place, ready when you need it.

    • Meeting notes pages come with built-in details— Title, Date, and Attendees. If your note is linked to a calendar event, these fill in automatically and show up as properties in your database, so your notes stay organized without extra setup. If you don't have a default meetings database yet, Notion creates a private My meetings database for you. You can move a note to a different meetings database when it belongs with a team or project.

    Set it and forget it with auto-share and auto-add

    • Add AI Meeting Notes to any event— When creating a new calendar event, just use the AI Meeting Notes and Docs section to attach a notes page. For existing pages, click the microphone icon to turn them into meeting notes, and AI will instantly add the note-taking block to the top.

    Make your meetings more effective

    Good meeting documentation reduces confusion, keeps everyone accountable, and ensures important decisions don't get lost in the shuffle. Here are five ways to keep your meetings productive and your notes actionable:

    Get everyone's okay first

    • Set your agenda beforehand—Share a clear agenda beforehand in the notes tab so everyone comes prepared. This helps keep discussions focused and ensures you cover key topics in the time available.

    • Pick your meeting style— Click the three dots menu to choose from four formats: Auto, Sales, Stand-up, or Team Meeting. Each one organizes your notes differently to match your meeting type, and you can customize them for your conversation.

    • Capture notes collaboratively and in real time—Since Notion AI looks at both the notes and transcription when creating summaries, encourage everyone to add their thoughts and highlights in the Notes tab. More input means better summaries!

    • Tag teammates in action items—When you jot things down in the Notes tab or share thoughts during the meeting, use @ mentions to tag teammates—this helps Notion AI turn those mentions into clear next steps everyone can act on.

    Save time by converting action items to tasks

    • Set up a meeting notes database—Keep all your meeting notes in one place by creating a dedicated database. This makes it super easy to find past notes and helps everyone build better documentation habits, especially when AI Meeting Notes is already part of your templates. Check out our course on creating a meeting notes database. Because meeting notes can be their own pages, they fit naturally in a database. Their built-in Title, Date, and Attendees details fill in automatically, so you can sort and filter your meetings without typing in the basics yourself. You can also turn an existing database into a meetings database. Existing pages stay the same. Turn your database into a meetings database from its settings and choose which date and attendees properties to use. New pages in the database can then be meeting notes. For recurring meetings, move the meeting note to the right database and choose to save future notes from that event series there too.

    Bring meeting insights into your projects database

    Keeping your meeting notes in a Notion database lets you easily connect them to related projects, tasks, or people using Relation and Rollup properties. It’s a simple way to make sure every discussion stays anchored in the right context. With this setup, teams can:

    • Connect notes to projects and tasks—Just like linking your marketing team's weekly feedback to project pages. This helps you keep track of all your campaign updates and decisions in one place, making it easy to look back at what happened when.

    • Tag teammates in action items and assign ownership right from the meeting note— When you're discussing product launches, you can connect all your decisions to your project pages and spec docs. This makes it super easy to look back at important discussions when you need them later during development.

    Let Notion AI handle post meeting tasks

    Once the meeting wraps up, your time should be spent moving work forward, not struggling to decode messy notes. AI Meeting Notes helps you stay focused on what matters— here’s how:

    • Get clear summaries after the meeting ends— AI will turn your notes and the transcription into organized meeting summaries after the meeting ends.

    • Share notes without over-sharing— All meeting notes have their own sharing settings. Select Share at the top of the note to send teammates the summary and transcript, without giving them access to anything else. If the meeting note was created from /meet, expand it into a full page first.

    Set up automations to share your meeting notes in Slack

    • Let AI help with meetings follow-ups— Get Notion AI help to draft follow up emails, project status updates, anything you need. For example, if you're a sales lead, get Notion AI to create a quick deal status update for leadership based on your client meeting notes.

    • Get quick answers from meeting history— Ask Notion AI questions about past meetings right from your workspace, like "What was decided about the new product launch timeline?" or "What was the final decision on the marketing budget?". Since your notes are connected, you'll get clear answers with links back to the original discussions.

    With AI Meeting Notes, you let Notion AI handle the documentation while you lead the discussion, collaborate with your team, and take action on what matters most.
